newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firms on crude gains, prompt still weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firms on crude gains, prompt still weak.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firmer on Friday on stronger crude and expectations of increased demand over the coming week, traders said.
Prompt Eurograde storage traded at $188.50 and $190 fob ARA, further out it was talked around $191/$191.50.
Running refinery material was slightly pricier, trading at $192 and $193 fob Rotterdam for full April delivery. May delivery material was talked around $194/$195 fob ARA.
Regular traded at $182 and $183 fob ARA in earlier trade.
Traders said prompt barge material continued to be pressured by aggressive selling by a Swiss trading house.
Some said the trader had been caught with material earmarked for export out of the region while others speculated the trader was attempting to lower quotes ahead of a delivery into the region.
On the whole, however, traders were mildly bullish for April and May delivery material with demand seen picking up considerably in the coming week as May approaches.
"The cargo situation has cleared up and the barge situation is also clearing up," said one trader. "Next week should be quite constructive." -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
